messages:
casey: FYI a partner hit bundler crash importing our SDK in Expo Go: metro fails resolving 'stream' from dist/index.mjs (we're ESM-only).
rina: Metro + ESM + conditional exports = pain. Are they on managed Expo Go?
casey: Yes, managed. Quick hack was extraNodeModules -> stream-browserify but bundle size + runtime errors made it unacceptable.
sam: Practical plan: add a small dist/rn build that avoids Node streams and uses AsyncIterable for token streaming, then set package.json 'react-native' to point at it. Metro will prefer that.
jess: Also runtime fallbacks: crypto.getRandomValues (Hermes) and AbortController shims. Simple runtime checks in the RN entry: if (!globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues) require('react-native-get-random-values'); if (!global.AbortController) require('abortcontroller-polyfill/dist/polyfill');
rina: TS issues too: our d.ts references Node types. Recommend shipping a tiny dist/rn/ambient.d.ts or change streaming types to AsyncIterable<string> to be cross-platform.
sam: I'll prototype a rollup target producing dist/rn/index.js with minimal shims and measure size.
jess: I'll draft RFC + docs: package.json fields (react-native/main/module), metro notes, polyfill checklist, TS quickstart, and an examples/expo-quickstart app for CI validation.
dev-bot: RFC #248 (sdk-rn-entrypoints) assigned to @jess, due in 5 days.
casey: Thanks — this will stop more confusing bug reports.
